settings.text: Questions, special requests, tricky photos, or just want to show me a picture of your dog? All of it is welcome here.

settings.heading: I answer every one myself
settings.text:
No teams, no bots, no copy-and-paste replies. Just me, usually with a cup of tea, getting back to you within a day.

If you're ordering a portrait for a pet who has passed away, please do tell me — I'll treat it with all the care it deserves.

settings.question: How quickly do you reply?
settings.answer: Usually within a day, sometimes within an hour if I'm at my desk. If a couple of days pass with nothing, check your spam folder and then nudge me again — I promise I'm not ignoring you.

settings.question: Can I ask for something custom?
settings.answer: Please do. Costumes, hats, a favourite blanket, two pets who never met, a background in your kitchen colours. If you can describe it, I'll tell you honestly whether I can draw it.

settings.question: Do you do commissions for businesses?
settings.answer: Yes — logos, mascots, illustrations for pet businesses. Message me with what you have in mind and we'll work out the licensing together.
